Stackurity told 59 organisations about ARTEX. Each organisation's administrators and security team got the email and the banner, and its notification routes the message.

Example of what one organisation got (no names are kept in this copy):

Subject: ARTEX: your connected assets are checked, nothing was found

> ARTEX is being used against systems on the public internet.

> Your connected assets are checked for it (3 servers with the agent) and nothing was found. You don't need to do anything.

> About ARTEX: ARTEX is an open-source, AI-driven penetration-testing framework (a Go server with a Next.js web console, default port 8787) published on GitHub in July 2026 and taken down on 8 October 2026; copies and forks still circulate. Criminal and state-aligned groups use it to automate intrusions against internet-facing systems, and the FBI warned about it on 13 November 2026. It is not a vulnerability: there is nothing to patch. Two prebuilt Docker Hub images (tomicdd/artex and congdonglinux/artex) were reported to carry a backdoored login handler.
